aiReviews.claim: Data Type Indicator must be alphanumeric and must not exceed 1 bytes.
aiReviews.sourceDetail: ATL105 defines Element 24 as Character Type AN, maximum one byte, fixed length one alphanumeric character. The source also enumerates punctuation markers (#, !, :, @, $, \, &, ^, %) and K; the precise intended meaning of generic 'alphanumeric' against the explicit symbol set requires source/Test interpretation.

aiReviews.claim: Data Type Indicator must be one of: DL3)., (No. DL4)., DL5)., (No. DL6)., Encryption and Tokenization., Encryption and Tokenization, (No. DL7).
aiReviews.sourceDetail: The AI statement is malformed and cannot be interpreted as a complete value set. ATL105 lists ten distinct single-character values (#, !, :, @, $, \, &, K, ^, %) with overlapping/contextual meanings for '&'; it maps the segment markers to DL1-DL8 and separately describes key-load response indicators.

sourceEvidence.quote: Character Type: AN Maximum Length: 1 byte
Representation: Fixed length of one alphanumeric character
Processing Rules: Required for TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization.
# Identifies the Merchant Data Segment (No. DL1).
! Identifies the Dial String Data Segment (No. DL2).
: Identifies the Date and Time Data Segment (No. DL3).
@ Identifies the Software Dial Load Data Segment (No. DL4).
$ Identifies the Software IP Load Data Segment (No. DL5).
\ Identifies the Store and Forward Data Segment (No. DL6).
& Indicates that a new Key and Key ID are being returned to a device using TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization.
& For EMV, indicates that a block of a new CA Public Key file is being returned to the device.
K Indicates that a new Key and Key ID are being returned to a device using TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization
^ Identifies the Supplemental Terminal Data Segment (No. DL7)
% Identifies EMV Floor Limits Segment (No. DL8)

fullTestModelReview.interpretation: The Test model has segment-specific framing rules for DL1-DL8 but no direct Element 24 code-set BR that exhaustively covers key-response '&'/'K' contexts. These candidates do not yet demonstrate complete enum coverage.

requiredFollowUp: Recover the intended complete enum from the source artifact/producer record for AI BR :028; do not repair the malformed list by guesswork.
Clarify whether Character Type AN includes all explicitly enumerated punctuation symbols under the ATL105 validator convention.
Determine whether '&' and 'K' require additional independent Test rules for their TransArmor/EMV key-load response contexts.
Add hash-bound positive, invalid-marker, and context-appropriate cases for DL1-DL8 and key-response meanings, with independent expected outcomes.
Review Data Type Indicator presence conditions: the source says it is required for specified key-load operations, not universally.
